subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】factory worker 工厂工人; postman 邮递员; businessman 商人; police officer 警察; fisherman 渔夫; scientist 科学家; pilot 飞行员; coach 教练
【重点句型】What does he/she do? 他/她是做什么的？ He's/She's a ... 他/她是一名…… Where does he work? 他在哪里工作？ He works ... 他在……工作。 How does he go to work? 他怎么去上班？
【A Let's talk】Oliver: What does your father do, Sarah? Sarah: He's a businessman. Oliver: Where does he work? Sarah: He works at sea. Oliver: How does he go to work? Sarah: By ship.
【Read and write】There are many jobs. My father is a doctor. He works in a hospital. My mother is a teacher. She works at school. My uncle is a postman. He works in a post office. My aunt is a scientist. She works in a university.
key_points: What does he/she do? 他/她是做什么的？
Where does he work? 他在哪里工作？
How does he go to work? 他怎么去上班？
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
